params.title: Why telling people your goal makes it harder

caption.instagram:
How to see your progress when you feel stuck: the Sunday test.

Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, reason #29: invisible progress. Tara practised singing 20 minutes a day for two months and every day sounded like the day before. You compare today with yesterday, and one day of practice is too small to notice. The change only shows across weeks.

The fix, the Sunday test:
- Same test every week (same song, same 2 km, same prompt)
- Never delete one
- In week 8, play week 1 first

What would you record every Sunday? Tell me below.
